explication: Agent Desktop exposes desktop observation and control through a Rust CLI and C ABI. The main loop is snapshot a UI, resolve a stable element reference, act through accessibility-aware checks, then observe again. Sessions and traces support bounded, shareable runs; optional CDP interop extends control to Chromium content, while the inspector provides a read-only UI. The tree and excerpts establish these major capabilities, but do not show platform adapter implementations, so their internal wiring is left abstract.
